programme.title: Serie A: Monza v Napoli
programme.desc: After being held to a thrilling 3-3 draw by Roma, Massimiliano Allegri's Napoli search for a big win as they travel to face Ivan Juric's Monza at Stadio Brianteo.

programme.title: Serie A: Juventus v Napoli
programme.desc: After a shock midweek defeat to Genoa, 36-time champions Juventus face a huge test against former boss Massimiliano Allegri and his Napoli side at Allianz Stadium.

programme.title: Serie A: Atalanta v Parma
programme.desc: Following their thrilling 4-4 draw with Frosinone, Maurizio Sarri's Atalanta go in search of their fourth Serie A win of the season as they take on strugglers Parma at Gewiss Stadium.

programme.title: Serie A: Inter v Como
programme.desc: Inter look to bounce back from their Milan derby defeat as they host Cesc Fabregas' in-form Como side, who have won their last four Serie A games.

programme.title: Serie A: Fiorentina v Juventus
programme.desc: After beating Napoli 2-0 last weekend, Luciano Spalletti's Juventus look to build some momentum in Serie A as they travel to face Paolo Vanoli's Fiorentina.

programme.title: Gloucester-Hartpury Women's RFC v Harlequins Women
programme.desc: Action from Premiership Women's Rugby as league leaders Gloucester-Hartpury look to extend their unbeaten run against the Harlequins at Kingsholm.

programme.title: Loughborough Lightning Women v Bristol Bears
programme.desc: Action from Premiership Women's Rugby as Loughborough Lightning face Bristol Bears at cinch Stadium. The Lightning won 31-19 when these sides last met.

programme.title: Harlequins Women v Saracens Women
programme.desc: Action from Premiership Women's Rugby as Harlequins go head-to-head with title chasers Saracens at Twickenham Stoop.

programme.title: Saracens Women v...
programme.desc: ...Gloucester-Hartpury Women's RFC. Action from the huge Premiership Women's Rugby showdown between title-chasing rivals Saracens and Gloucester-Hartpury at StoneX Stadium.

programme.title: Leicester v Saracens
programme.desc: Saracens look to continue their unbeaten start to Group B of the PREM Rugby Cup as they face reigning champions Leicester Tigers at Mattioli Woods Welford Road.

programme.title: Rolex Spirit of Yachting
programme.desc: Coverage of the Rolex Middle Sea Race, a 606-nautical-mile event which sets sail from the historic Grand Harbour in Valletta.

programme.title: MLB World Series - Game 5
programme.desc: Action from game five at Tropicana Field. Can Tampa Bay Rays keep their World Series dream alive, or will the Milwaukee Brewers lift the title for the first time?
